units.source_text: 匂亲王为了教二女公子弹琴，在二条院居住了三四天。

en.t: Prince Niou stayed at the Nijo residence for three or four days in order to teach the Second Princess to play the koto.

units.source_text: 他以日子不好、不宜出行为借口，不到六条院去，六条院里的人就怨恨起来。

en.t: He used the unlucky day and its unsuitability for travel as an excuse not to go to Rokujo-in, and the people there began to resent him.

units.source_text: 这一天夕雾左大臣从宫中退出，亲自来到二条院。

en.t: That day, Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, withdrew from the palace and came in person to the Nijo residence.

units.source_text: 匂亲王闻之，咕哝地说：“如此大张旗鼓地到这里来做什么呢？”

en.t: When Prince Niou heard of it, he muttered, "What is he coming here for with such a grand show?"

units.source_text: 便走出房间，到正殿里迎接。

en.t: Then he left his room and went to the main hall to receive him.

units.source_text: 夕雾说道：“只因无甚要事，久不到这里来了。

en.t: Yugiri said, "Since there has been no particular business, I have not come here for a long time.

units.source_text: 今日睹物思人，不胜感慨呢！”

en.t: Today, seeing these things and remembering the people connected with them, I cannot help being deeply moved."

units.source_text: 谈了些二条院的旧事之后，便带着匂亲王回六条院去了。

en.t: After talking a little about old times at the Nijo residence, he took Prince Niou with him back to Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 随从的有夕雾的诸公子、高官贵族、殿上人等，冠盖如云，气势盛大。

en.t: Among the attendants were Yugiri's sons, high officials, nobles, and courtiers, with carriages and caps gathered like clouds in magnificent display.

units.source_text: 二条院里的人看了，都觉万难和他家并比，不免心情颓丧。

en.t: When the people at the Nijo residence saw this, they felt there was no way they could compare with that household, and they could not help growing dejected.

units.source_text: 众侍女都来窥看左大臣，也有人说：“这位大臣真漂亮啊！

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting all came to steal a look at the Minister of the Left, and some said, "What a handsome minister he is!

units.source_text: 他的公子也是如此，个个正当盛年，相貌堂堂，不过没有一人赶得上父亲。

en.t: His sons are the same way, each in the prime of youth and splendid in appearance, but not one of them can match their father.
Ah, he truly is a beautiful man!"

units.source_text: 然而似乎也有人说：“如此身份高贵的人，特地亲自来接女婿，未免太过分了！

en.t: Yet it seems there were also people who said, "For someone of such high rank to come personally and especially to fetch his son-in-law is going too far!
This world has fallen into a sorry state."

units.source_text: 二女公子本人呢，回想自己过去的生涯，但觉终不能和这声势烜赫的人家相并肩，只是相形见绌。

en.t: As for the Second Princess herself, when she looked back on her own past life, she felt that she could never stand alongside such a brilliant and powerful household, and could only suffer by comparison.

units.source_text: 从此心情越发颓丧，更加痛切地希望：“还不如无忧无虑地闲居在山乡中，最为安稳。”

en.t: From then on her spirits sank even further, and she longed all the more painfully, "It would be far better and most peaceful to live quietly and free from care in a mountain village."

units.source_text: 不知不觉之间，这一年又告终了。

en.t: Before anyone realized it, the year had come to an end once again.
